description: An embedding \(f:M\hookrightarrow N\) of first-order structures is injective, preserves every interpreted function including constants, and preserves and reflects every interpreted relation.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Embedding.{u, v, w, w'} (L : FirstOrder.Language) (M : Type w) (N : Type w') [L.Structure M]
  [L.Structure N] : Type (max w w')
